evidence: Using XRD (Fig. S4), it can be seen that N-doped Ti phosphate (using TMP*) is amorphous as deposited. However, upon annealing up to 950 ◦C in a He atmosphere, peaks that can be linked to crystalline TiP2O7 (JCPDS #00-038-1468) appear. Like the thin films that are deposited with TMP*, the films deposited with DEPA* are also amorphous.
